✊ Martin Luther King Jr. – Courage That Changed a Nation

This image highlights the powerful journey of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., a man who reshaped history through unwavering courage and purpose.

During his 12 years leading the Civil Rights Movement, King was arrested 30 times, faced threats, setbacks, and organized movements that were met with fierce opposition. Many believed his efforts would fail but he refused to be silenced.

Instead, every challenge only strengthened his mission to end racial segregation and discrimination in America. 🌍✊

His determination, leadership, and non-violent approach inspired millions and reshaped an entire generation. In 1964, he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, honoring his impact on humanity. 🕊✨

A reminder that true change doesn’t come without resistance, it comes from those who stand firm in their purpose, no matter the cost.
